# Examples for scatterplotter
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(methylationhelper)

B_memory = c("Bmem0008", "Bmem0017", "Bmem0192", "Bmem0055", "Bmem0187", "Bmem0031")
B_naive = c("Bn0149", "Bn0067", "Bn0046", "Bn0188", "Bn0150", "Bn0139")

data("GSE174666")

GSE174666_imputed <- mean_imputation(GSE174666)

healthy_averages = data.frame(
  mean_mature = GSE174666_imputed[,colnames(GSE174666) %in% B_memory] %>% rowMeans(),
  mean_immature = GSE174666_imputed[,colnames(GSE174666) %in% B_naive] %>% rowMeans()
) %>%
  mutate(mature_minus_immature = mean_mature - mean_immature)
```

```{r}
GSE171424_imputed <- mean_imputation(GSE171424)
beta_query <- GSE171424_imputed
beta_query_diff = apply(beta_query, 2, function(x){x - healthy_averages$mean_immature}) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(beta_query_diff) <- rownames(beta_query)
```

```{r}
methylation_scatter(query_minus_immature = beta_query_diff[,1:3], reference_averages = healthy_averages, cutoff_value=0.2, alpha =0.1, 
                    name_immature = "Naive B cell", name_mature = "Memory B cell", name_tumor = "Tumor",
                    colorslice=TRUE, whichslice="hypo")
```


```{r}
test = scatter_based_probelist(query_minus_immature = beta_query_diff[,1:3], reference_averages = healthy_averages, whichslice="hypo")

lapply(test, function(x){nrow(x)})
```

# Subtraction-based method of coming up with probelist

```{r}
GSE171424_list = vec_to_list(annotation_GSE171424$cell_type, annotation_GSE171424$sampleid)
head(GSE171424_list)
```

```{r}
GSE174666_list = vec_to_list(annotation_GSE174666$cell_type, annotation_GSE174666$sampleid)
head(GSE174666_list)
```

```{r}
GSE171424_avg = calc_group_avg(betadf = GSE171424_imputed, l_groupings = GSE171424_list) %>% as.data.frame()
GSE174666_avg = calc_group_avg(betadf = GSE174666_imputed, l_groupings = GSE174666_list) %>% as.data.frame()

head(GSE171424_avg)
head(GSE174666_avg)
```

```{r}
# Comparison = query - reference
referencecolumn = "memory B"
IGA_compare = GSE171424_avg - GSE174666_avg[,colnames(GSE174666_avg) %in% referencecolumn]
colnames(IGA_compare) <- paste0(colnames(GSE171424_avg), " vs ", referencecolumn)
```

```{r}
l_comparisons = df_to_list(df=IGA_compare)
```

```{r}
# set the cutoff for the query to be "differentially methylated" from the reference
cutoff = 0.2

# CPGIDs hypermethylated in query compared to reference
l_cutoff_up = lapply(l_comparisons , function(x){x[which(x >= cutoff)]})

# CPGIDs hypomethylated in query compared to reference
l_cutoff_down = lapply(l_comparisons, function(x){x[which(x <= -cutoff)]})
```

```{r}
l_df_query_up = list_of_beta_subset(betadf = GSE171424_imputed , list_of_cpgs = l_cutoff_up, list_of_groupings = GSE171424_list)

# the lenghth of the list of references should match that of the list of query
# we are using the memory B cells as the reference and replicating that for each item on the list of queries.

l_df_reference_up = list_of_beta_subset(betadf = GSE174666_imputed , list_of_cpgs = l_cutoff_up, list_of_groupings = GSE174666_list, 
                                        name_of_reference = "memory B")
```

```{r}
l_df_query_down = list_of_beta_subset(betadf = GSE171424_imputed , list_of_cpgs = l_cutoff_down, list_of_groupings = GSE171424_list)

# the lenghth of the list of references should match that of the list of query
# we are using the memory B cells as the reference and replicating that for each item on the list of queries.

l_df_reference_down = list_of_beta_subset(betadf = GSE174666_imputed , list_of_cpgs = l_cutoff_down, list_of_groupings = GSE174666_list, 
                                        name_of_reference = "memory B")
```

```{r}
l_wil_up = fun_wilcoxon(list_of_cpgs = l_cutoff_up, list_of_dfs_ref = l_df_reference_up, list_of_dfs_query = l_df_query_up)
names(l_wil_up)<- names(l_comparisons)
```

```{r}
l_wil_down = fun_wilcoxon(list_of_cpgs = l_cutoff_down, list_of_dfs_ref = l_df_reference_down, list_of_dfs_query = l_df_query_down)
names(l_wil_down)<- names(l_comparisons)
```

```{r}
lapply(l_wil_up, function(x){sum(x$pval_fdr < 0.05)})
```
